title: Fragmented Securities Regulation, Information-Processing Costs, and Insider Trading
eligible_reason: No staggered TWFE design. The core comparison is cross-sectional: insider Form 4 filings by stand-alone banks (fdic = 1, filed with the FDIC) vs bank holding companies (fdic = 0, filed with the SEC). Tables 5-7 regress filing-level CARs, raw returns and abnormal volume on fdic plus time-varying bank and trade controls ($xlist) with year FE only (no unit FE); Table 7 adds CEM/entropy-balancing weights and propensity-score matching (psmatch2). Table 3 is a logit/LPM of SAB-to-BHC switching (switch_year). Table 8 interacts fdic with earnings-surprise rank (continuous moderator) with firm and quarter FE. Table 9 is a filing event-window design (post = trading days 0-5 after each filing, fdic x post, filing and event-day FE, controls), i.e. stacked around filings. Only 6 of 141 banks in table7b.dta change fdic status, and no regression uses unit FE with fdic as a switching treatment.
design_notes: Filing-level data 2000s-2010s. fdic = SAB indicator; switch_year = SAB transitions to BHC. Outcomes: dec_* (size-decile-adjusted CARs), abvol_* (abnormal volume), ret60/300/900 and abvol60/300/900 (intraday TAQ), ind_bsi/large_bsi (retail/large order imbalance), buy/sell/bsi (insider trading around equity issues, Table 10: sab x preissue).
estimators_reported: cross-sectional OLS with year FE and controls
n_adoption_cohorts_note: SAB-to-BHC switching is staggered but only 6 switchers in table7b.dta and never used as a TWFE treatment.

specs.exclusion_reason: cross-sectional comparison (no unit FE, treatment not switching within units); time-varying controls
specs.controls: lnmve tieronecap deposit loan amihud tradesize ceo cfo

specs.exclusion_reason: filing event-window design (post defined relative to each filing; filing FE); time-varying controls
specs.treatment_var: fdic_post = fdic x post (post = trading days 0-5 after filing)

screener_notes: Screened from package only (Readme.pdf, tables.do in full, table7b.dta inspected for within-bank fdic variation). No article text available.
